workflow.name: Agent with Clarification
workflow.description: Chat Trigger -> Agent Orchestrator (with built-in agent_clarify tool) -> Output. Demonstrates the agent_clarify pause primitive: when the agent calls the built-in `agent_clarify` tool, the workflow result carries a top-level `clarification` field with the question. The chat UI renders that as a '?' bubble. The user's NEXT chat message in the same session resumes the agent naturally via session memory — the runtime injects the reply as the tool result for the pending clarify call, so the LLM sees a clean tool-call → tool-result exchange instead of an orphaned tool call.

config.systemPromptTemplate: You are a concise assistant. When the user's request is ambiguous in a way that materially changes the answer, call the `agent_clarify` tool with a focused question. Otherwise answer directly. Don't ask for confirmation on things that are already clear.
